component: Flatpak and Snap repack tool ownership

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The follow-up pairs include-run-task with repack commands at /builds/worker/bin/fetch-content. It also replaces the broad COPY pattern with explicit file-extension globs to avoid copying the injected run-task directory into /scripts. The original Flatpak glob list does not contain the later accepted *.json addition. These are concrete comm input/caller changes; the unpaired upstream macro body and a successful image/package build remain unverified. Required Bug comment 18 is missing, so this finding has zero full-audit credit.
title: The packaging follow-up changes both injected inputs and the fetch-content caller path
